title: Short-term barrier option price expansion
summary: We derive a short-maturity expansion for up-and-out put barrier option prices under continuous stochastic volatility when the strike and the barrier approach the spot at the diffusive scale. Assuming joint weak convergence of the normalized terminal return, the relative volatility fluctuation, and the running maximum, together with uniform integrability, we show that the leading term is the time-inhomogeneous Black-Scholes barrier price fitted to the forward variance curve.
